title: AssistantMessageListResult

content.title: Content
content.description: The message content sent by the assistant (can be a string or an array of content parts)

message_id.title: Message Id
message_id.description: The unique identifier of the message.

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: The unique identifier of the agent that owns the message.

conversation_id.title: Conversation Id
conversation_id.description: The unique identifier of the conversation that the message belongs to.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: The time the message was created in ISO format.

description:
Assistant message list result with agent context.

Shape is identical to UpdateAssistantMessage but includes the owning agent_id and message id.
